mapper.select: SELECT member_id AS memberId, performance_title AS performanceTitle, #{year} AS year, #{month} AS month, #{week} AS week, #{now} AS settlementWeeklyCreatedAt, SUM(settlement_daily_sales_amount) AS weeklySalesAmount, SUM(settlement_daily_refund_amount) AS weeklyRefundAmount, SUM(settlement_daily_gross_amount) AS weeklyGrossAmount, SUM(settlement_daily_commission) AS weeklyCommission, SUM(settlement_daily_net_amount) AS weeklyNetAmount FROM settlement_daily WHERE COALESCE(settlement_daily_updated_at, settlement_daily_created_at) > #{lastTimeSeconds} AND (settlement_year || '-' || lpad(settlement_month, 2, '0') || '-' || lpad(settlement_day, 2, '0'))::date BETWEEN #{from}::date AND #{to}::date GROUP BY member_id, performance_title ORDER BY member_id LIMIT #{_pagesize} OFFSET #{_skiprows};
